answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit before joining a shared terrace of services, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Reputation then accrues only through verified completed work, like verses in a sonnet that must rhyme with real history, not through self-declared claims. A saffron-colored trust score, earned slowly and slashed on fraud, makes one honest long-lived identity far more valuable than a swarm of cheap disposable ones.
